recording.output: {"interfaces":"Concept journal — recover and keep the conceptual design. Reach for it when you need the design or a recorded change. Overview (context overview): read a context’s whole account, its open decisions and cuts in flight; use first when recovering a context. Design (conceptual design): read current concepts; use when their present meaning is needed. Work package — find recorded work and its dependencies. Reach for it to plan or recover a cut’s work. State (ledger): read the cut’s phase, packages and ready work; use when finding what is dispatchable next.","skills":["To recover the design, first call concept_journal overview, then design for details.
